text.p: MediaConcepts Inc on Tuesday said it named Donna Anderson to the position of chief executive, replacing Paul Andre, who resigned.
On Monday, Paul Andre said he resigne d over disagreements with management over the way the company was being run.
The company also confirmed in a statement that Andre's wife, Sandra Andre, resigned as chief financial officer.
Robert Torres was named to replace her. He has 12 years experience in the financial arena, including assisting private companies in their transition to publicly trading companies, MediaConcepts said.
In other changes, MediaConcepts said it appointed David Garcia as director and executive vice president. Garcia was formerly executive producer for NBC in charge of miniseries.
The company also said it has acquired a library of 374 films. In its statement, MediaConcepts did not say from whom the library was acquired or how much it paid.
